name: Omo, Queen of Vesuva
oracle_text:
Whenever Omo enters or attacks, put an everything counter on each of up to one target land and up to one target creature.
Each land with an everything counter on it is every land type in addition to its other types.
Each nonland creature with an everything counter on it is every creature type.
blocked_sentences: Each land with an everything counter on it is every land type in addition to its other types.
Each nonland creature with an everything counter on it is every creature type.

needs.what: A way for a static to say 'is every creature type' (205.3m, the changeling characteristic) for the objects its `affects` matches -- e.g. an `add_subtype` flag `all_creature_types: true` -- that the subtype readers (creature_types_of, shares-a-creature-type checks, subtype filters, tribal cost reductions and triggers) treat as matching every creature type, rather than a finite literal list.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_subtype` only grants a literal `subtypes` list; enums.SUBTYPE_CLASS enumerates land, artifact, enchantment and planeswalker types but not creature types, so there is no registry to list exhaustively, and the shipped Maskwood Nexus template's 30-type list is an approximation that fails any creature type not on it. There is no `changeling` keyword in `keywords`.

needs.what: Rule 305.6 -- a land that gains a basic land type gains the matching intrinsic mana ability ({T}: Add {W}/{U}/{B}/{R}/{G}), derived in the characteristics pipeline so an `add_subtype` grant of Plains/Island/Swamp/Mountain/Forest brings the mana abilities with it, visible to legality, the payment solver and activation.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The type change itself is sayable as {"effect": "add_subtype", "affects": {"types": ["Land"], "has_counters": ...}, "subtypes": [every land type in enums.SUBTYPE_CLASS]}, but the engine never derives a mana ability from a granted basic land type, so the land would be every land type in name only and tap for nothing new -- the main effect of the line. Same blocker as Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Ashaya.
